title: Dandy’s World Tier List (2026): All 40 Toons Ranked by Role After 1.0
summary: Dandy's World tier list for 1.0: all 40 playable Toons ranked S to C with stats, roles and reasons, plus the best Toons for beginners, solo runs and The Labs.
body_markdown:
**Quick answer:** the best Toons in *Dandy’s World* after the 1.0 update are **Vee** and **Gourdy** for finishing Machines, **Pebble** for pulling Twisteds away, and **Sprout** , **Shelly** and **Astro** for keeping the team alive. The best cheap unlock is **Looey** (1,000 Ichor). **Shrimpo** is last on purpose: he’s a challenge Toon with one star in every stat.


This Dandy’s World tier list ranks all **40 playable Toons** as of version 1.0.5 (November 24, 2026). Every stat comes from the game data on the fan wiki, and every ability is described as it works in the game. The tiers themselves are **our opinion** : a tier list is always a judgment call, so we show our reasons and the raw stats, and you can rearrange it for your own playstyle.


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


How We Ranked the Toons


#


Every Toon has five stats rated from 1 to 5 stars: **Skill Check** , **Movement Speed** , **Stamina** , **Stealth** and **Extraction Speed** , plus Hearts for health. Regular and event Toons have 15 stars and 3 Hearts. Main Characters get 16 stars but only 2 Hearts. That trade-off matters a lot in later Floors.


We placed each Toon by looking at three things:


1. **Stats for their job.** Extractors want high Skill Check and Extraction. Distractors (runners) want Movement, Stamina and Stealth.
2. **How much the ability changes a run.** Abilities that heal, reveal Twisteds or save a teammate beat abilities that only help in rare situations.
3. **How easy the Toon is to get.** Holiday Toons are still ranked, but we flag that you can only unlock them during their event.


We ranked for normal runs on later Floors, where the gap between Toons is clearest. Dandy, Dyle, Dessa and Dioda are left out because players can’t use them in normal runs (more on that below). Stats are from the[fan-run Dandy’s World Wiki stats list](https://dandys-world-robloxhorror.fandom.com/wiki/Toons_Statistics_List) , checked on November 25, 2026, and the 1.0 details are from the[official Roblox game page](https://www.roblox.com/games/16116270224/Dandys-World) .


##


Dandy’s World Tier List at a Glance


#


Tier Toons What it means


**S** Vee, Gourdy, Shelly, Sprout, Astro, Pebble Build your team around these


**A** Soulvester, Squirm, Yatta, Glisten, Waxwell, Looey, Blot, Goob, Eclipse, Bobette, Ginger, Cosmo, Tisha, Connie Strong picks, a small step below S


**B** Boxten, Poppy, Brusha, Finn, Gigi, Rodger, Eggson, Brightney, Cocoa, Flyte, Flutter, Coal, Rudie, Razzle & Dazzle, Bassie, Teagan, Scraps, Ribecca Solid, fun or situational


**C** Toodles, Shrimpo Luck-based or challenge picks


Want the details? Each tier below lists the role, the exact star spread and the reason behind the pick.


##


S Tier: The Best Toons in Dandy’s World


#


S-tier Toons either finish Machines faster than anyone else or keep the whole team alive. Five of the six are Main Characters, which only have 2 Hearts, so they reward careful play.


Toon Role Stats (Skill / Move / Stamina / Stealth / Extraction) Why it ranks here


**Vee** Extractor 4 / 2 / 3 / 2 / 5 Mic Check highlights every Twisted and Machine for a few seconds, and her passive highlights the 2 nearest unfinished Machines. Add 5-star Extraction and she always knows where to go next.


**Gourdy** Extractor (Halloween) 5 / 4 / 1 / 1 / 5 5-star Skill Check and Extraction with 4-star Movement. Trick or Treat gives nearby Toons a random 20% boost, and Sugar Rush speeds up the team when the Elevator opens. Only sold during the Halloween event.


**Shelly** Support / Extractor 5 / 3 / 2 / 3 / 3 5-star Skill Check, and Inspiration gives one teammate +75% Extraction Speed for 15 seconds. She makes any extractor near her better.


**Sprout** Support (healer) 2 / 4 / 5 / 3 / 2 Baked Sweets heals a teammate by 1 Heart for Tapes, and his passive shows every alive Toon and their health. 5-star Stamina helps him reach whoever needs help.


**Astro** Support 2 / 3 / 2 / 5 / 4 Nap Time fully restores nearby Toons’ Stamina, and he can see teammates who are low on Stamina. 5-star Stealth keeps him out of trouble.


**Pebble** Distractor 3 / 5 / 4 / 3 / 1 5-star Movement and 4-star Stamina. Speak! pulls nearby Twisteds toward him, so he can drag them off the team and outrun them. His passive also highlights items.


Astro, one of our S-tier Support picks, in official art for Here In Your Dreams. © BlushCrunch Studio


##


A Tier: Strong Picks


#


A-tier Toons are great in the right team. Most of them are cheaper than the Mains and have 3 Hearts, which makes them more forgiving.


**Soulvester** Extractor / Support (Halloween) 5 / 1 / 1 / 3 / 5 5-star Skill Check and Extraction, and Soul Shield spends a Heart to block a hit for a teammate. 1-star Movement and Stamina mean he can’t escape long chases, which keeps him out of S tier for us.


**Squirm** Extractor 3 / 3 / 2 / 2 / 5 5-star Extraction, and Distressed Delicacy eats books for +100% Extraction Speed. The best regular extractor once you learn where books spawn.


**Yatta** Extractor / Support 3 / 4 / 1 / 2 / 5 5-star Extraction and 4-star Movement. Piñata Party drops candy items after Machines and when she’s hurt. Watch her 1-star Stamina.


**Glisten** Extractor 2 / 3 / 3 / 2 / 5 5-star Extraction, and Reflection teleports him to a targeted Toon, which doubles as an escape. His 2-star Skill Check is the weak spot.


**Waxwell** Distractor / Support 5 / 5 / 1 / 2 / 2 5-star Skill Check and 5-star Movement. Ignite leaves a flame trail that speeds up teammates’ ability cooldowns, which is great with ability-heavy teams.


**Looey** Distractor 4 / 3 / 3 / 2 / 3 Heart of Helium makes him faster for every Heart he’s missing, so he gets harder to catch the more he’s hit. At 1,000 Ichor he’s the best-value unlock on this list.


**Blot** Distractor 1 / 4 / 5 / 3 / 2 5-star Stamina, and Blot Jr. places a decoy that lures nearby Twisteds away from the team.


**Goob** Support 3 / 4 / 4 / 2 / 2 Hug! pulls another Toon toward him, which can yank a teammate out of a chase. 4-star Movement and Stamina.


**Eclipse** Distractor (Halloween) 3 / 4 / 3 / 2 / 3 Total Eclipse turns him into a werewolf during Blackouts, with 5-star Movement and Stamina while it lasts. Strong on Blackout Floors, average otherwise.


**Bobette** Support (Christmas) 4 / 3 / 5 / 2 / 2 Precious Packaging hides her in a gift box, invincible for 8 seconds, and Festive Aura gives nearby Toons faster Stamina regen and a speed boost. Only sold during the Christmas event.


**Ginger** Support (Christmas) 3 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 3 Baked with Care! heals a teammate to full Hearts for Tapes. A full heal is huge late in a run. Christmas event only.


**Cosmo** Support 1 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 3 Sharing is Caring gives one of his own Hearts to heal a teammate. Cheap at 1,000 Ichor and a solid healer for new players.


**Tisha** Support 4 / 4 / 2 / 3 / 2 Tidy Up! sends a team speed pulse that also clears Ichor puddles. Only 500 Ichor.


**Connie** Extractor / Stealth 2 / 1 / 3 / 5 / 4 5-star Stealth and 4-star Extraction, and Haunting Escape turns her invisible to most Twisteds for 5 seconds. 1-star Movement is her big weakness.


##


B Tier: Solid and Situational Toons


#


B-tier Toons aren’t bad. They are great for learning the game, for filling a gap in your team, or for anyone who just likes them. Tier lists don’t decide who’s fun to play.


**Boxten** All-rounder 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 Even 3-star stats, and Wind-Up gives more Extraction Speed for every alive Toon. Free as a starter (or 100 Ichor).


**Poppy** All-rounder 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 Even 3-star stats, and Panic Pop gives a speed burst when she’s attacked. The other free starter (or 100 Ichor).


**Brusha** Extractor 4 / 3 / 3 / 2 / 3 Artistic Inspiration paints Machines to speed up extraction and Skill Checks. Good, but slower to pay off than A-tier extractors.


**Finn** Extractor 4 / 3 / 2 / 3 / 3 4-star Skill Check, and Reel In gives a speed boost whenever a Machine is completed. Cheap at 500 Ichor.


**Gigi** Extractor 5 / 3 / 1 / 3 / 3 5-star Skill Check, and Surprise! gives her a random item from any tier. Random items make her swingy.


**Rodger** Researcher 3 / 2 / 3 / 3 / 4 Detective doubles the Research he gets from Capsules and Twisted encounters. Amazing for unlocking Trinkets and Toons, less so for surviving.


**Eggson** All-rounder (Easter) 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 Fixer Upper adds 20% progress the first time he touches a Machine. Easter event only.


**Brightney** Extractor 3 / 3 / 4 / 1 / 4 4-star Extraction, and Night Light lights up Twisteds during Blackouts. Her 1-star Stealth makes her easy to spot.


**Cocoa** Support (Easter) 3 / 4 / 2 / 4 / 2 Bonbon places a candy that boosts extraction and speed. Easter event only.


**Flyte** Support (Easter) 2 / 4 / 2 / 3 / 4 Gust places a wind zone that speeds up Toons. Easter event only.


**Flutter** Distractor 2 / 4 / 4 / 3 / 2 Floaty Dash is a very fast short dash for escapes.


**Coal** Scout (Christmas) 2 / 4 / 4 / 3 / 2 Scout highlights items across the map for everyone. Christmas event only.


**Rudie** Distractor (Christmas) 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 Antler Charge is a quick forward charge to escape. Christmas event only.


**Razzle & Dazzle** Flex 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 (base; Move and Extraction swap between 5 and 1 by Floor) Comedy/Tragedy swaps Movement and Extraction by Floor: 5-star Movement and 1-star Extraction on odd Floors, the reverse on even Floors.


**Bassie** Support (Easter) 1 / 5 / 4 / 4 / 2 5-star Movement. Springful Sharing drops items from her inventory for teammates, and Easter Basket gives her an extra item slot. Only 2 Hearts as a Main, and her 1-star Skill Check holds her back.


**Teagan** Self-healer 3 / 3 / 4 / 2 / 3 Tea Time spends Tapes to heal herself by 1 Heart. Useful, but it only helps her.


**Scraps** Mobility 2 / 2 / 5 / 3 / 3 5-star Stamina, and Crafty Grapple pulls her to a Toon or Machine.


**Ribecca** All-rounder (Halloween) 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 / 3 The Undead makes her immune to debuffs and gives her a random buff instead. Halloween event only.


##


C Tier: Luck and Challenge Picks


#


**Toodles** All-rounder 3 / 3 / 3 / 4 / 2 Beginner’s Luck rolls a boost to a random stat. You can’t plan around it.


**Shrimpo** Challenge Toon 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 One star in every stat (5 total) and very low Stealth. He’s meant as a challenge, not a carry. Play him for bragging rights.


##


Best Toons by Role


#


###


Best extractors


#


**Vee** , **Gourdy** , **Squirm** , **Soulvester** , **Yatta** and **Glisten** . All six have 5-star Extraction. Pair them with Shelly for an even faster Machine.


###


Best distractors


#


**Pebble** , **Looey** , **Blot** and **Waxwell** . Good distractors have high Movement or Stamina and something that pulls or fools Twisteds.


###


Best support and healers


#


**Sprout** , **Astro** , **Shelly** , **Ginger** , **Cosmo** and **Goob** . A team with one healer and one Stamina support survives far more Floors.


###


Best Toons for beginners


#


Start with **Boxten** or **Poppy** (your free starter), then save for **Looey** or **Cosmo** (1,000 Ichor each), or **Tisha** and **Finn** (500 Ichor each). Regular Toons have 3 Hearts, so they forgive more mistakes than Mains. Most Toons in Dandy’s Store also need an unlock task before you can buy them.


###


Best Toons for solo runs


#


Solo, nobody can heal you or pull Twisteds away, so pick Toons that help themselves. In our opinion, **Vee** (she finds Machines and Twisteds on her own), **Connie** (invisibility to escape), **Squirm** (fast Machines) and **Teagan** (self-heal) are the easiest solo picks. Abilities that only target teammates, like Sprout’s heal or Glisten’s teleport, lose most of their value solo.


##


Best Toons for The Labs (1.0)


#


The 1.0 update added **The Labs** , a new game mode with 11 Floors, run by Dessa. It also brought Lab Cards and a new currency, Ambrosia. The mode is only a few days old, so treat this part as early thoughts, not a settled meta.


- **Hiding abilities got better.** Since patch 1.0.5 (November 24, 2026), Twisteds under Dessa’s control give up the hunt when a Toon hides using an ability, like Bobette’s or Connie’s. That makes Connie, who you can buy any time of year, a strong Labs pick.
- **Finding Machines still wins.** Vee’s highlights and Shelly’s Inspiration help on long, unfamiliar Floors.
- **Healers stay valuable.** The Labs is a long run, so Sprout, Ginger and Cosmo keep their value.


The Labs, the new game mode added in Dandy’s World 1.0. © BlushCrunch Studio


##


Christmas Toons: Where They Rank


#


The four Christmas Toons are **Bobette** (Christmas Main), **Ginger** , **Coal** and **Rudie** . You can only buy them with Ornaments during the Christmas event. In our list, Bobette and Ginger are A tier and Coal and Rudie are B tier.


BlushCrunch Studio has said the annual Christmas event is coming back, but as of November 25, 2026 it hasn’t announced a start date. Last year’s event ran from December 12, 2025 to January 16, 2026. If you plan to buy Christmas Toons, start saving Ichor now: Bobette also costs 2,500 Ichor on top of her Ornament price.


##


Why Dandy, Dyle, Dessa and Dioda Aren’t Ranked


#


These four are **Lethal Toons** . They have 5 stars in every stat (25 total), but they are developer/testing Toons that players can’t use in normal runs. Dessa and Dioda joined in 1.0 as developer-only Toons, and in the game they run The Labs and a shop. Ranking them next to normal Toons wouldn’t be fair, so we left them out. Want their story? Read[Dandy’s World lore explained](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/dandys-world-lore) .


Dessa, one of the four developer-only Lethal Toons, in official art for Finishing the Work. © BlushCrunch Studio


##


Make Your Own Dandy’s World Tier List


#


Disagree with our list? Good, that’s half the fun. Here’s a quick way to make your own:


1. Pick what you’re ranking: best for teams, best for solo, best for The Labs, or simply your favorites.
2. Write down each Toon’s five stats and their ability. Our[full Dandy’s World characters list](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/dandys-world-characters) has every ability and price in one place.
3. Decide what matters most for your goal. For solo runs, for example, self-sufficient abilities should count more than team buffs.
4. Use any free tier list maker (search for a Dandy’s World template) and drag the Toons in. Share it and compare with friends.


##


Where Would Your OC Rank?


#


Making a Dandy’s World OC? Give them a fair stat spread first. A regular Toon has **15 stars** over five stats and 3 Hearts. A Main Character has **16 stars** and 2 Hearts. Then give them one ability (Mains get an active and a passive) and ask where they’d land on this list:


- **S-tier OC:** an ability that changes the whole team’s run, like healing or revealing Twisteds, paired with 5 stars in their main job.
- **Balanced OC:** a useful ability with a clear weakness, like 5-star Extraction but 1-star Stamina.
- **Challenge OC:** a Shrimpo-style Toon with low stats and a funny or tricky ability.

##


FAQ


#


###


Who is the best Toon in Dandy’s World?


#


In our opinion, Vee is the best all-round pick after 1.0: she has 5-star Extraction and can highlight every Twisted and Machine. Gourdy has even stronger extraction stats but is only sold during the Halloween event. For support, Sprout and Astro are the top choices.


###


Who is the worst Toon in Dandy’s World?


#


Shrimpo. He has one star in every stat and very low Stealth, because he’s designed as a challenge Toon. Toodles is also low on our list because his ability boosts a random stat.


###


What is the best cheap Toon in Dandy’s World?


#


Looey, at 1,000 Ichor. Heart of Helium makes him faster for every Heart he’s missing, so he’s a strong distractor for very little Ichor. Tisha and Finn (500 Ichor each) are good budget picks too.


###


How many Toons are in Dandy’s World?


#


There are 44 Toons as of the 1.0 update, and 40 of them are playable. The other four, Dandy, Dyle, Dessa and Dioda, are developer-only Lethal Toons.


###


Is this Dandy’s World tier list official?


#


No. It’s a fan-made tier list. The stats and abilities come from the game and the fan wiki, but the tier placements are our opinion and can change with future balance updates.
